title: Collections Standard: Gate Lockout, Notice of Intent to Tow and Towing under the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
This standard governs an unpaid balance on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement. The day figures are those of the collections timetable of the space class. The delinquency date is the due date of the oldest unpaid period. An agreement becomes delinquent when rent for a billing period is still unpaid when its grace period ends, and a delinquent agreement returns to active standing when the past-due balance is paid in full before a tow notice is sent.

1. **Gate lockout.** For an unpaid balance the tenant gate code is suspended at the gate-lockout day of the class, counted after the due date of the oldest unpaid period.
2. **Notice of intent to tow — timing.** The notice of intent to tow may be sent only when the handling date is not earlier than the delinquency date plus the tow-notice day count of the class. Day counts start the day after the anchor date, and the step is allowed on the day the count is reached.
3. **Notice of intent to tow — effect.** The notice is sent by certified mail and email and moves the agreement to tow-noticed standing. The former words that the notice posts the tow notice fee of the class are **no longer in force**; they have been superseded by the current basis for the tow notice fee.
4. **Tow.** The vehicle may be towed only when the handling date is not earlier than the tow notice date plus the minimum days after notice of the class, and the towing company's own charges are paid by the tenant directly to the towing company.
5. **Payments.** While delinquent, payments of any amount are accepted. The former rule that after the tow notice only a payment of the full balance is accepted, returning the agreement to active and restoring the gate code, is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded. Partial payments follow the class settings: before the tow notice, a payment below the balance is accepted where the class accepts it while delinquent; after the tow notice, the class setting for payments after the tow notice governs.
6. **Returned payments.** A returned bank payment is reversed and posts the returned-payment fee of the class; the fee applies to a payment returned unpaid for insufficient funds or a closed account.
7. **Active-duty military.** No tow notice or tow proceeds against a vehicle of a tenant whose profile shows active-duty military status; such a case is referred to the district office. The customer profile, not the tenant's statement, is the record for this.

### Day-count illustration (hypothetical, 30-day tow notice count and 15-day minimum)

| Anchor | Count reached on | Earliest date |
|---|---|---|
| Delinquency date 1 June | 1 July (day 30 counted from 2 June) | Notice of intent to tow on 1 July, not on 30 June |
| Tow notice dated 1 July | 16 July (day 15 counted from 2 July) | Tow on 16 July, not on 15 July |

A tenant whose profile shows active-duty military status receives neither the notice nor the tow, whatever the day count.

superseded_clauses: after the tow notice only a payment of the full balance is accepted, and it returns the agreement to active and restores the gate code.
